title: The Long Ear
summary: Optional. Teth, Nereid's moon: the dish that talks to Sol. Reach the hub (ear-silent: nothing has ever come back down it; Meridian is silent), then take the three tuning plates and hold them while the dish swings (countdown tuning; wardens come). Sets long-ear: a one-way channel to Sol, years of lag (read by the Covenant and Proof endings).

objectives.text: Reach the hub of the dish
Hold all three tuning plates until the dish is tuned

tags: act 2, teth, long ear, optional, countdown
notes: The hold, as on Vess: tuning starts when all three plates are held at once (ear-tuning) and is done once the countdown has run out with all three held again. Wardens (faction ear-wardens) appear on ear-tuning.
